settings:title: Settings
settings:section.sound__note: Section heading covering audio and haptics. Max 14 characters.
settings:section.sync__note: Section heading, shown ONLY when something is actually waiting. Max 20 characters.
settings:sync.waiting: {count, plural, one {# lesson hasn't reached the server yet} other {# lessons haven't reached the server yet}}. Nothing is lost — it will try again.
settings:sync.waiting__note: Shown when work has exhausted its retries. States what is true and ends on the reassurance. NEVER 'sync failed': the work is safe, it just has not arrived, and a child reading 'failed' hears 'your lessons are gone'.
settings:sync.retry__note: Manually retries work the queue parked. Max 24 characters.
settings:section.premium__note: Section heading for subscription status, billing and restore. A product name — leave untranslated unless the market expects otherwise. Max 14 characters.
settings:premium.active: Premium is on. Thank you — it pays for the maps.
settings:premium.active__note: Shown to a current subscriber. Warm and specific about where the money goes. Never a badge or a status bar; they already know.
settings:premium.trial: {count, plural, =0 {Your free trial ends today} one {# day left of your free trial} other {# days left of your free trial}}. We'll remind you before it renews.
settings:premium.trial__note: Shown during a free trial. States the date the charge lands, unprompted — a user who knows does not file the chargeback. ICU plural including =0 for the last day.
settings:premium.ending: Premium runs until the end of the period you've paid for. Turning renewal back on is one tap in the store, whenever you like.
settings:premium.ending__note: Shown after the user turns off auto-renew and before access actually ends. A fact, once, with no offer attached — no discount, no 'are you sure', no guilt. They still have what they paid for and we say so.
settings:premium.see__note: Opens the paywall from Settings, only when the user goes looking. No badge, no red dot. Max 16 characters.
settings:premium.manage__note: Opens the store's own subscription settings, where cancelling lives. Burying cancellation is a dark pattern and neither store allows an app to do it in-app anyway. Max 22 characters.
settings:goal.label: Daily goal
settings:goal.label__note: Row label — how many minutes a day the user aims for. Max 14 characters.
settings:goal.value: {minutes, plural, one {# minute a day} other {# minutes a day}}
settings:goal.value__note: The chosen daily goal. ICU plural.
settings:goal.help: You can change this any time. A missed day is not a failure.
settings:reminder.label: Daily reminder
settings:reminder.label__note: Toggle label for the once-a-day notification. Max 16 characters.
settings:reminder.help: One a day, at a time you choose. Never more.
settings:sound.label: Sound effects
settings:haptics.label: Vibration
settings:haptics.label__note: Toggle label for haptic feedback. Max 14 characters.
settings:motion.label: Reduce motion
settings:motion.help: Follows your device setting unless you change it here.
settings:language.label: App language
settings:language.label__note: Label of the picker inside the Language section. Max 16 characters.
settings:language.system__note: Language option that follows the OS setting rather than a fixed choice.
settings:language.en__note: Always written in the language itself, never translated.
settings:language.sv__note: Swedish, written in Swedish. Never translate a language name.
settings:privacy.policy__note: Row that opens the privacy policy. Max 18 characters.
settings:privacy.terms__note: Row that opens the terms. Max 18 characters.
settings:privacy.analytics.label: Help improve WorldQuest
settings:privacy.analytics.help: Anonymous usage data. Never on for a child account, never sold, never shared.
settings:privacy.account.title: Your data
settings:privacy.account.title__note: Heading of a short explanation, not a link. Max 14 characters.
settings:privacy.account.body: You are learning without an account, so nothing here identifies you. When accounts arrive, exporting and deleting your data will live here.
settings:about.version__note: Row label next to the app version number. Max 12 characters.
settings:about.licences__note: Row that lists the libraries and fonts we use. Max 24 characters.
settings:about.credits: Map and flag data comes from open sources, listed with every fact.
settings:on__note: Accessibility state for a switch that is enabled.
settings:off__note: Accessibility state for a switch that is disabled.
settings:sync.pending: {count, plural, one {# lesson is waiting to reach the server} other {# lessons are waiting to reach the server}}. It will go as soon as you're online.
settings:sync.pending__note: Shown when work is queued but has NOT exhausted its retries — a lesson finished on a train, thirty seconds ago. Distinct from sync.waiting, which is about work that gave up. Both end on reassurance; neither ever says 'failed'.
settings:avatar.label: Choose your avatar
settings:avatar.label__note: Heading for the row of avatar portraits the user picks from.
settings:avatar.none__note: The option that shows the user's initials instead of a portrait. Max 12 characters.
settings:avatar.option__note: Spoken label for one portrait. Numbered rather than described, so it does not assert what the character looks like. {number} and {total} are integers.
